discovery_notes: Pink a la Mode Disney pins 2021-2022 via 30 search snippets, almost all Disney Pins Blog release posts plus Disney Pin Forum. Pink a la Mode recorded as retailer only (posts say made exclusively for PALM); no maker stated. Several sets list pairings/characters equal to pin count; one-pin-per-entry inferred and flagged in not_found. Only one 2021 release (Sept debut) found, designs unnamed.
